Lina: Okay this is wild 1 I got promoted to Director of Product and were also expecting a baby in November. One inbox, two tiny humans to manage. :tada: :baby: 
Omar: WHOA!! Huge congrats Lina!!! Director + parenthood = legend status. Pics of bump when available :raised_hands:
Jess: Congrats!! Director title looks good on you. Also whens the baby registry? Need gift inspo.
Lina: Thanks!! Registry link here: https://registry.example/linababy (gender-neutral stuff). Also open to hand-me-down onesies.
Priya: Double celebrations call for cake + mocktail. Vote: office shower on Nov 10 or a lunchtime dessert pop-up? React with :one: for Nov 10 in-person, :two: for a virtual afternoon treat.
Sam: :one: in-person if possible. If not, Ill mail cookies to remote folks.
Karen (People Ops Bot): @lina congrats! I created an "Lina Celebration" calendar event for Nov 10 at 3pm in the kitchen and added a virtual join option. Please RSVP and indicate dietary needs & gift contributions: https://forms.company/celebrate-lina (auto-reminder 2 days prior).
Evan: Congrats Lina!! Im remote but happy to chip in for a group gift and send a baby book. Also we should probably add a Slack thread for baby name suggestions (pure chaos guaranteed).
Mei: Love this. Quick question: do you want office plants or toys? I vote plants until the baby arrives. :seedling:
Omar: Also shoutout: director power = extra budget for snacks, right? Asking for the cake. :grin:
Jess: Ill bring a neutral "congrats" banner and a small onesie that says "I test in prod" :joy:
Lina: Thank you all so much 1 overwhelmed and grateful. Registry is up, dates TBD but Nov 10 works for a mini celebration. Love the "I test in prod" onesie idea. See you then! :heart:
